name: Coorg Cuisine
area: College Road, opposite Post Office, Madikeri
why_it_matters: Madikeri's oldest dedicated Kodava restaurant — a first-floor room opposite the Post Office, walls hung with antique guns and portraits (including Field Marshal Cariappa), serving the home-cooked Coorg food locals send outsiders to. Pandi curry with kadambuttu (rice dumplings) and the bella (jaggery) coffee after lunch are the reference order.
insider_tip: It is small (about 50 seats), worn-in and can have a 10-15 minute wait at lunch — go before 1pm. Pork and bamboo-shoot dishes are the strengths; finish with the bella coffee. Pocket-friendly portions. Cash and UPI.
signature_address: Coorg Cuisine, First Floor, opposite Post Office, College Road, Madikeri, Kodagu, Karnataka 571201

name: Tiger Tiger Ethnic Kodava Dining
why_it_matters: A tiny family-run Kodava kitchen set up in the family's own backyard a short walk downstairs from Raja Seat — so unassuming it does not look like a restaurant. Reviewers describe it as 'local food from a local home', the most genuinely homemade Coorg meal in Madikeri.
insider_tip: It is barely a restaurant — just a few tables in a backyard, so call ahead or arrive early; capacity is tight. Pandi and chicken curry with kadambuttu is the order. Pair it with a Raja Seat sunset walk. Cash and UPI.
signature_address: Tiger Tiger Ethnic Kodava Dining, near Raja Seat, Madikeri, Kodagu, Karnataka 571201

name: Taste of Coorg
signature_dish: Authentic pandi curry with neer dosa
why_it_matters: A tiny canteen-style Kodava eatery — only about five tables — repeatedly cited on Tripadvisor as one of the best authentic-Coorg meals in Madikeri. The pandi curry with neer dosa and the Coorg-style chilli chicken are the dishes reviewers come back for.
insider_tip: With only five tables you will likely wait — go early for lunch and accept some items may sell out. Authentic over polished: it is about the food, not the room. Homemade desserts are worth saving room for. Cash and UPI.
signature_address: Taste of Coorg, Madikeri, Kodagu, Karnataka 571201

name: East End Hotel
signature_dish: Chicken biryani and Coorg-style meat dishes
why_it_matters: A long-standing Madikeri bar-and-restaurant from the British era, on Stuart Hill with hill-and-valley views — locals and tourists head here for biryani, mutton and the pandi ghee roast. One of the town's most established sit-down dining names.
insider_tip: It is a licensed bar-restaurant, so a drink with dinner is easy here. They no longer carry full pandi curry — order the pandi ghee roast instead. Ample parking; reasonably priced. Cash, UPI and cards.
signature_address: East End Hotel, Stuart Hill, Madikeri, Kodagu, Karnataka 571201

name: Raintree Restaurant
why_it_matters: A restaurant set in a gorgeous heritage-style bungalow in Madikeri — the more atmospheric, sit-down option among Coorg's mostly utilitarian eateries. The menu is largely pan-Indian but includes local Kodava dishes; appams with stew and the tender-coconut payasam are signatures.
insider_tip: Come for the setting as much as the food — the bungalow and grounds are the draw. Appam-and-stew and the payasam are the standouts; the Kodava dishes are a smaller part of the menu. Cash, UPI and cards.

name: The Canopy — Capitol Village Resort
signature_dish: Kodava plantation thali with pandi curry
why_it_matters: The in-house restaurant at Capitol Village Resort, a family-run Kodava property set in a coffee plantation about 5 km from Madikeri town. The Canopy puts a full plantation-style Kodava spread on the table — kadambuttu, papputtu, noolputtu and akki otti with pandi curry soured by kachampuli vinegar, alongside the estate's home-grown coffee.
insider_tip: This is a resort restaurant out of town — day visitors should call ahead, as in-house guests get priority. Best as part of a plantation visit rather than a quick town meal. Cards, UPI and cash accepted.
signature_address: The Canopy, Capitol Village Resort, Madikeri, Kodagu, Karnataka 571201
